about: How a major renovation differs from a regular one

A major renovation changes what is hidden in walls and floors: wiring, pipes, screed. For resale housing this is often a necessity — old utilities are 30–40 years old, and new furniture and appliances will not save an apartment whose board cannot carry the load.

If wiring and pipes are fine and the apartment only needs refreshing — wallpaper, paint, flooring, doors — a cosmetic renovation without replacing the engineering is enough. When the utilities are decades old, we honestly recommend a major renovation. We also take on the rough stage alone if you do the finishing with another team.
How much a major renovation costs in Kyiv

A turnkey major renovation costs from $550 per m². The price includes works and rough materials: cables, pipes, mixes, waterproofing, plasterboard. Finishing materials (tiles, flooring, doors, sanitaryware), furniture and appliances are estimated separately — here the budget depends most on your choices.

For a typical 60 m² two-room apartment the lower bound at base rates is 60 m² × $550 = $33,000. The exact figure comes from the estimate after a paid site survey. If CAS carries out the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate.

If you are not in Kyiv, the renovation can be managed remotely. Every 1–2 weeks we send photo reports, concealed works are accepted stage by stage with certificates, and material decisions are agreed remotely. The timeline is fixed in the contract — from 2 weeks depending on the scope.
